paras_en: US stocks rose broadly on Monday, with major tech stocks rebounding strongly, as President Trump canceled a planned attack on Iran, leading to a sharp decline in international oil prices and a significant increase in risk appetite. The Dow Jones Industrial Average surged nearly 700 points to a new record high, while the Nasdaq Composite Index jumped over 2% and the S&P 500 Index approached its historic high.

In addition to the rebound in tech stocks, the easing of tensions between the US and Iran was also a key factor driving the stock market higher. Despite Iran's denial of direct negotiations with the US, President Trump claimed that the two sides were still in contact, with the first phase focusing on the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, followed by negotiations on Iran's nuclear program.

Trump also issued an ultimatum to Iran on Monday, warning Tehran that this was the 'last chance' to sign a good agreement, or face 'decapitation'. International oil prices plummeted in response, with Brent crude oil futures falling 4.73% to $83.77 per barrel and West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil futures dropping 5.11% to $80.34 per barrel. The decline in oil prices also slightly eased concerns about a resurgence in inflation.

US bond yields fell in tandem, with the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield declining nearly 6 basis points to around 4.688%, reflecting the market's reduced concerns about inflation pressure following the drop in oil prices.

On the economic data front, the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) reported that the US manufacturing purchasing managers' index (PMI) rose 2.3 percentage points to 55.6 in July, above the 50 threshold that separates expansion from contraction, indicating a continued improvement in manufacturing activity.

The most closely watched data this week is the July non-farm payroll report, which is scheduled to be released on Friday. The market expects the number of new jobs to increase further, providing more clues about the state of the US labor market and the Federal Reserve's future policy direction.

The major US stock indexes performed as follows on Monday: the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 693.38 points, or 1.32%, to 53,178.41; the Nasdaq Composite Index surged 540.04 points, or 2.13%, to 25,913.90; the S&P 500 Index gained 110.78 points, or 1.48%, to 7,600.50; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 119.28 points, or 1.05%, to 11,430.35; and the NYSE FANG+ Index jumped 490.80 points, or 2.84%, to 17,752.15.

In focus, most of the big tech stocks in the NYSE FANG+ Index rose. Meta (META-US) soared 6.02%, while Apple (AAPL-US) fell 1.78%. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) surged 4.88%, Microsoft (MSFT-US) jumped 4.93%, and Amazon (AMZN-US) rose 4.58%.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was broadly higher, with AMD (AMD-US) up 1.78%, Broadcom (AVGO-US) rising 0.76%, Nvidia (NVDA-US) surging 2.93%, Applied Materials (AMAT-US) gaining 2.08%, Qualcomm (QCOM-US) up 2.68%, and Micron (MU-US) rising 0.79%.
Taiwanese stocks were mixed, with TSMC ADR (TSM-US) up 0.46%, ASE ADR (ASX-US) surging 4.29%, UMC ADR (UMC-US) falling 1.79%, and Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT-US) down 0.42%.

In company news, Apple (AAPL-US) fell about 1.8% to $303.42, its fourth consecutive decline, as Alphabet's (GOOGL-US) market capitalization surpassed Apple's, making Apple the third-largest US company by market value.

Amazon (AMZN-US) soared 4.58% to a record high of $284.02, its best day since May 5, with its market capitalization exceeding $3 trillion for the first time. Amazon's rally continued from last week's strong second-quarter earnings report, which beat market expectations.
SpaceX (SPCX-US) rose 5.68% to $114.53 ahead of its second-quarter earnings report on Tuesday. As of Monday's close, SpaceX's stock price was still about 15.2% below its IPO price of $135.

Boeing (BA-US) surged 8% to $233.49 after receiving a rare 'double upgrade' and certification from the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). BNP Paribas upgraded Boeing's rating from 'sell' to 'buy' and raised its target price from $230 to $300.
Alibaba ADR (BABA-US) jumped 4.13% to $127.30 after the Chinese e-commerce giant released its new AI model, Qwen 3.8-Max, which boosted market confidence.

According to Michael Monaghan, portfolio manager at Founder ETFs, the selling pressure on AI-related stocks has eased after the liquidation of Situational Awareness, a hedge fund founded by former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner. Meanwhile, the market's concerns about the Middle East situation over the weekend have been alleviated by the US's rhetoric and attitude, which suggest that all parties are trying to resolve the issue through negotiations.

However, investors remain cautious. Adam Crisafulli, founder of Vital Knowledge, noted that similar easing of tensions has occurred in the past, and the US-Iran conflict is still far from being truly resolved, so the market's willingness to chase prices remains relatively restrained.

items.title: 川普下最後通牒！伊朗不達協議將面臨「斬首」
items.title_en: Trump Issues Ultimatum to Iran, Warning of 'Decapitation' if No Deal is Reached
paras: 美國總統川普週一 (3 日) 對伊朗發出最後通牒，警告德黑蘭若不把握「最後機會」與美國達成和平協議，可能面臨「斬首」。川普宣稱雙方目前仍在接觸，第一階段將處理荷姆茲海峽重新開放問題，之後再推進伊朗非核化談判，但伊朗否認正與美國直接協商。
川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室表示，這一輪談判「並不複雜」，預料進展速度將比以往更快。他聲稱，荷姆茲海峽最快「明天」就可能全面開放，並將其稱為協議的第一階段。
待海峽通航問題解決後，雙方將進入第二階段，討論伊朗非核化。川普坦言，相關談判可能需要一段時間，並再次強調伊朗必須實現非核化；不過，伊朗一向堅稱其核計畫僅供民用。
川普說：「這是他們簽署一份好協議的『最後機會』。」
當記者追問這次談判與過去有何不同時，他進一步表示，希望在採取「斬首」行動前，給伊朗所有可能的「最後機會」。
川普並未說明「斬首」的具體含義，但透露美方原定採取的軍事行動尚未完全取消，並形容相關計畫「非常強硬」。
他表示，執行這項行動並非容易的決定，美方將視後續情勢發展再作判斷。
川普上週曾警告將「非常猛烈地」打擊伊朗，攻擊範圍可能包括能源基礎設施，但週末暫緩空襲，轉而繼續尋求外交解決。他宣稱，美方原本規劃的攻勢一旦展開，將成為「第二次世界大戰以來規模最大的攻擊」。
川普表示，沙烏地阿拉伯、阿拉伯聯合大公國、卡達等國領袖曾聯繫華府，希望美國再給外交斡旋一次機會，因此他決定暫緩軍事行動。
不過，美伊雙方對談判狀態的說法明顯矛盾。
伊朗外交部表示，德黑蘭並未與華府協商重開荷姆茲海峽或終結戰爭，目前僅與阿曼討論設置一條「臨時航線」，讓船隻安全通過這條重要能源運輸走廊。
川普隨即在社群平台 Truth Social 痛批伊朗領導階層「令人難以置信地口是心非」。他聲稱，伊朗方面主動尋求會談，甚至可以說是在「懇求」談判，卻又公開宣稱沒有與美國接觸。
川普表示，無論伊朗是否願意承認，美伊都在尋找解決方案。他並警告，在達成協議或伊朗「全面投降」以前，美國將繼續限制物資進入伊朗。
《CBS News》則引述消息人士指出，目前並未安排任何美伊之間的「新一輪」直接談判，雙方只是持續透過中間人傳遞訊息。因此，川普所稱的談判可能是指間接接觸，而非正式的面對面協商。
美國與以色列 2 月 28 日對伊朗發動突襲，華府與德黑蘭隨即陷入戰爭。雙方 6 月曾透過一份諒解備忘錄達成停火，原本希望以此作為推動更廣泛和平談判的基礎，但停火協議隔月便因雙方恢復互相攻擊而破裂。
川普此後多次在大規模軍事威脅與外交談判之間轉換立場。由於伊朗否認正與美國直接談判，雙方在荷姆茲海峽管理權及核計畫等議題上仍存在重大分歧，這一輪接觸能否促成停火或更廣泛的和平協議，仍待觀察。
paras_en: US President Trump issued an ultimatum to Iran on Monday, warning that if Tehran does not seize the 'last chance' to reach a peace agreement with the US, it may face 'decapitation'. Trump claimed that the two sides are still in contact, with the first phase focusing on the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, followed by negotiations on Iran's denuclearization. However, Iran has denied direct negotiations with the US.

Trump stated in the Oval Office that this round of negotiations is 'not complicated' and is expected to progress faster than before. He claimed that the Strait of Hormuz could be fully reopened as early as 'tomorrow', calling it the first phase of the agreement.

After the issue of the strait's navigation is resolved, the two sides will enter the second phase to discuss Iran's denuclearization. Trump admitted that the related negotiations may take some time and again emphasized that Iran must achieve denuclearization. However, Iran has consistently claimed that its nuclear program is for civilian use only.

Trump said, 'This is their last chance to sign a good agreement.' When asked by reporters what is different about this round of negotiations compared to the past, he further stated that he wants to give Iran every possible 'last chance' before taking 'decapitation' action.

Trump did not elaborate on the meaning of 'decapitation' but revealed that the US has not completely canceled the planned military action and described the plan as 'very tough'. He stated that executing this action is not an easy decision, and the US will make a judgment based on the development of the situation.

Trump had previously warned that he would 'very strongly' strike Iran, with potential targets including energy infrastructure, but suspended the airstrike over the weekend and continued to seek a diplomatic solution. He claimed that the planned attack, if launched, would be 'the largest attack since World War II'.

Trump stated that the leaders of Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Qatar had contacted Washington, hoping that the US would give diplomacy another chance, which is why he decided to suspend military action.

However, the US and Iran have clearly contradictory statements about the status of the negotiations. The Iranian Foreign Ministry stated that Tehran has not negotiated with Washington on reopening the Strait of Hormuz or ending the war and is currently only discussing the establishment of a 'temporary navigation line' with Oman to allow ships to safely pass through this important energy transportation corridor.

Trump immediately criticized the Iranian leadership on the social media platform Truth Social, calling them 'incredibly dishonest'. He claimed that the Iranian side had sought talks, even 'begging' for negotiations, but then publicly claimed they had no contact with the US.

Trump stated that regardless of whether Iran is willing to admit it, both the US and Iran are seeking a solution. He warned that the US will continue to restrict the flow of goods into Iran until an agreement is reached or Iran 'fully surrenders'.

CBS News quoted sources as saying that there are currently no scheduled 'new rounds' of direct negotiations between the US and Iran, and the two sides are only continuing to pass messages through intermediaries. Therefore, the negotiations mentioned by Trump may refer to indirect contact rather than formal face-to-face negotiations.

The US and Israel launched a surprise attack on Iran on February 28, and Washington and Tehran immediately became embroiled in war. The two sides reached a ceasefire through a memorandum of understanding in June, hoping to use it as a basis for promoting broader peace negotiations, but the ceasefire agreement collapsed the following month due to renewed mutual attacks.

Trump has since repeatedly shifted his stance between large-scale military threats and diplomatic negotiations. Due to Iran's denial of direct negotiations with the US, significant differences remain between the two sides on issues such as the management of the Strait of Hormuz and nuclear programs. It remains to be seen whether this round of contact can lead to a ceasefire or a broader peace agreement.

items.title: 資金棄AI轉抱金融股 補漲行情能走多遠看Fed下一步
items.title_en: Funds Shift from AI to Financial Stocks, But How Long Can the Rally Last?
paras: 金融股本月成為市場表現最佳的族群之一，強勁的銀行財報、資本市場活動改善，以及市場對私人信貸風險的擔憂降溫，吸引投資人重新布局這個今年以來落後大盤漲勢的產業。不過，聯準會（Fed）下一步政策動向，可能決定這波資金輪動行情還能延續多久。
標普 500 金融類股近期漲勢正面臨一項考驗，即金融股能否成為更具持續性的市場領漲力量，並為投資人提供科技股與人工智慧（AI）投資主導市場之外的另一項選擇。
Edward Jones 投資策略分析師魏默（Brock Weimer）指出，觀察近期已公布的銀行財報，他認為本月以來的上漲走勢相當合理。不過他也提醒，7 月 29、30 日市場劇烈的震盪再次凸顯出，通膨與利率疑慮仍能迅速扭轉金融股的看漲前景。
財報強勁支撐金融股多頭論點
隨著第二季財報季加速展開，摩根大通 (JPM-US) 、高盛 (GS-US) 與摩根士丹利 (MS-US) 等大型銀行表現搶眼。魏默表示，整體財報表現確實非常出色，且針對民間信貸的隱憂，以及 AI 對數據密集型金融業務構成的威脅，市場焦慮情緒皆已有所緩解。
State Street Investment Management 首席投資策略 Michael Arone 則認為，金融股基本面的好轉，尚未完全反映在其估值中。
根據 FactSet 數據，截至上週五的統計，標普 500 指數金融成分股第二季獲利成長率達 19.4%，營收則成長 12.6%；該產業利潤率亦隨之擴大，在標普 500 指數的 11 個產業板塊中排名第三。
然而，然而，Arone 指出，金融股目前交易價格，仍較大盤折價超過 30%。
Arone 表示，金融股多頭論述並不僅建立在獲利表現上，企業併購（M&A）與首次公開募股（IPO）活動改善、信貸環境穩健，以及銀行股息與庫藏股回購計畫，都進一步提升金融股吸引力。
綜合考量這些因素，State Street 已在第 3 季展望中，將金融股評等由「中立」調升至「正向」。
Fed 政策與殖利率曲線成關鍵
儘管財報強勁，但金融股仍面臨再次升息與通膨居高不下的風險。
Fed 上週連續第 5 次將基準利率維持在 3.5% 至 3.75% 區間不變，但有 3 名官員支持升息，使市場對貨幣政策方向的疑慮升溫。
根據芝商所（CME Group）的 FedWatch 工具顯示，截至上週四下午，期貨交易員預測最快於 9 月升息的機率已來到 63.2%。
利率走向對銀行至關重要，主因銀行通常以短期利率支付存款利息，同時賺取長期貸款與證券的利差。
但若 Fed 升息，且存款成本上升速度快於銀行資產收益率，淨利差（NIM）可能受到壓縮。長期維持高利率環境，也可能削弱貸款需求，並提高未來信用損失風險。
Globalt Investments 合夥人暨資深投資組合經理 Keith Buchanan 表示，這項風險可能抵銷支撐金融股上漲的其他利多因素。
他指出，若通膨阻礙 Fed 降息腳步，甚至迫使央行再次升息，銀行可能必須提高存款利率以留住資金。若長期利率未同步上升，銀行放貸收益與資金成本之間的利差可能收窄，進而壓縮淨利息收入。
paras_en: Financial stocks have become one of the best-performing groups in the market this month, driven by strong bank earnings, improved capital market activity, and easing concerns over private credit risks, attracting investors to reposition in an industry that has lagged the broader market rally so far this year. However, the Federal Reserve's next policy move may determine how long this rotation can last.

The recent rally in S&P 500 financial stocks is facing a test of whether they can become a more sustainable market leader and provide investors with an alternative to tech and AI-driven investments. Edward Jones investment strategy analyst Brock Weimer notes that the recent bank earnings reports have been quite reasonable, but warns that the market's sharp fluctuations on July 29 and 30 highlight that inflation and rate concerns can quickly reverse the outlook for financial stocks.

The strong earnings reports have supported the bullish case for financial stocks. As the second-quarter earnings season gains momentum, major banks such as JPMorgan Chase (JPM-US), Goldman Sachs (GS-US), and Morgan Stanley (MS-US) have delivered impressive performances. Weimer states that the overall earnings performance has been excellent, and concerns over private credit and the threat of AI to data-intensive financial businesses have eased.

Michael Arone, chief investment strategist at State Street Investment Management, believes that the improvement in financial stocks' fundamentals has not been fully reflected in their valuations. According to FactSet data, as of last Friday, the S&P 500 financial sector's second-quarter earnings growth rate reached 19.4%, with revenue growth of 12.6%, and the industry's profit margin has expanded, ranking third among the 11 industry sectors in the S&P 500.

However, Arone notes that financial stocks are still trading at a discount of over 30% to the broader market. Arone argues that the bullish case for financial stocks is not just based on earnings performance, but also on improved M&A and IPO activity, a stable credit environment, and banks' dividend and share buyback plans, which have further enhanced the attractiveness of financial stocks.

Taking these factors into account, State Street has upgraded its outlook for financial stocks from 'neutral' to 'positive' in its third-quarter forecast. Despite strong earnings, financial stocks still face the risk of further rate hikes and high inflation. The Fed left its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.5%-3.75% for the fifth consecutive time last week, but three officials supported a rate hike, fueling market uncertainty about the direction of monetary policy.

According to the CME Group's FedWatch tool, as of last Thursday afternoon, the probability of a rate hike as early as September had risen to 63.2%. The direction of interest rates is crucial for banks, as they typically pay short-term interest rates on deposits and earn a spread on long-term loans and securities. However, if the Fed raises rates and deposit costs rise faster than bank asset yields, net interest margins (NIM) may be compressed.

Globalt Investments partner and senior portfolio manager Keith Buchanan warns that this risk could offset other positive factors supporting the rally in financial stocks. He notes that if inflation prevents the Fed from cutting rates, or even forces it to raise rates again, banks may need to increase deposit rates to retain funds. If long-term rates do not rise in tandem, the spread between bank lending yields and funding costs may narrow, compressing net interest income.

items.title: 製藥業大型併購案醞釀中｜阿斯特捷利康傳洽談必治妥施貴寶
items.title_en: Major Pharmaceutical Merger in the Works: AstraZeneca in Talks with Bristol Myers Squibb
paras: 2026年08月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 英國製藥商阿斯特捷利康AstraZeneca(AZN-US)傳出正與美國藥廠必治妥施貴寶Bristol Myers Squibb(BMY-US)洽談合併。若交易完成，合併後公司市值將接近4000億美元，可望躋身全球規模最大的製藥企業之一，並成為近年全球製藥產業規模最大的併購案之一。
根據《金融時報》報導，雙方近幾個月已就潛在交易展開協商，目前談判仍在進行中。報導指出，交易可能在短期內達成，也可能延後，甚至最終破局。
阿斯特捷利康近年持續擴大腫瘤、罕見疾病及免疫療法布局，核心產品涵蓋肺癌、乳癌等癌症治療，以及ADC藥物與免疫療法；必治妥施貴寶則積極強化細胞治療與血液腫瘤業務，日前才宣布以15億美元現金收購未上市生技公司Orbital Therapeutics，希望藉由其新一代RNA平台，加速開發CAR-T細胞療法，提升治療效率，並擴大該療法的應用。
市場認為，若雙方順利合併，將可整合腫瘤、免疫疾病及細胞治療等產品與研發資源，形成涵蓋標靶治療、免疫療法、ADC及CAR-T細胞療法等多元技術平台，進一步提升全球競爭力。

paras_en: On August 4, 2026, it was reported that UK-based pharmaceutical company AstraZeneca (AZN-US) is in talks with US-based Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY-US) for a potential merger. If the deal is completed, the combined company's market value would be close to $4 trillion, making it one of the largest pharmaceutical companies globally and one of the biggest mergers in the industry in recent years.

According to a report by the Financial Times, the two companies have been in negotiations over a potential deal for several months, with talks still ongoing. The report suggests that the deal could be reached in the short term, but it may also be delayed or ultimately fall through.

AstraZeneca has been expanding its portfolio in oncology, rare diseases, and immunotherapy in recent years, with core products covering cancer treatments such as lung and breast cancer, as well as ADC drugs and immunotherapy. Meanwhile, Bristol Myers Squibb has been strengthening its cell therapy and hematological oncology business, recently announcing the acquisition of privately-held biotech company Orbital Therapeutics for $1.5 billion in cash, aiming to accelerate the development of CAR-T cell therapy using Orbital's next-generation RNA platform.

The market believes that if the two companies merge successfully, they will be able to integrate their products and research resources in oncology, immunology, and cell therapy, forming a multi-technology platform that covers targeted therapy, immunotherapy, ADC, and CAR-T cell therapy, further enhancing their global competitiveness.

items.title: 全球製藥業最大併購案醞釀中｜阿斯特捷利康傳洽談合併必治妥施貴寶
items.title_en: World's Largest Pharmaceutical Merger Brewing: AstraZeneca in Talks to Merge with Bristol Myers Squibb

items.title: 737 Max 7苦等近十年終於過關！波音股價大漲 分析師喊上450美元
items.title_en: 737 Max 7 Finally Clears Nearly Ten‑Year Hurdle! Boeing Shares Surge as Analyst Calls $450 Target
paras: 綜合外媒報導，波音 737 Max 7 在歷經近十年的審查後，正式獲得美國聯邦航空總署 (FAA) 認證，結束受到兩起致命空難與品質問題干擾的漫長程序。與此同時，市場上唯一看空波音的法國巴黎銀行大幅上調投資評等，認為公司股價到 2030 年有望升至 450 美元，激勵波音 (BA-US) 周一 (3 日) 盤中一度大漲 6.8%。
FAA 表示，已向 737 Max 7 核發修訂後的型別檢定證，這項批准反映監管機關與波音多年來持續處理複雜技術問題，並完成對飛機設計及相關安全分析的全面審查。
波音表示，正與西南航空 (LUV-US) 合作，準備交付首架 737 Max 7。這款機型可搭載 135 至 160 名乘客，最大航程約 3800 海里，主要客戶正是西南航空。波音官網顯示，目前尚有 282 架 Max 7 未交付訂單。
波音商用飛機執行長 Stephanie Pope 向員工表示，取得認證是公司復甦過程中的關鍵時刻，也讓波音能以更有利的條件迎接未來。
波音預期，今年也能取得 737 Max 10 認證。《彭博》先前報導，最多可搭載 210 名乘客的 Max 10 可能於今年秋季獲准。兩款機型完成認證，對補齊 737 產品線、增加現金流並改善資產負債表至關重要。
法國巴黎銀行分析師 Matthew Akers 同日將波音評等一口氣上調兩級，由「遜於大盤」升至「優於大盤」，並將目標價調高至 300 美元，與 Baird 並列《彭博》追蹤分析師中的最高水準。
Akers 表示，市場對波音自由現金流的預估已降得太低。隨著 Max 與 777 系列部分機型陸續完成認證，加上公司降低債務，未來一年營運風險可望明顯下降。他認為，波音在新冠疫情後充滿不確定性的時代已經結束，股價有機會擺脫 2020 年初以來的 150 至 250 美元區間。
他預估，波音淨槓桿將於未來一年回到接近疫情前的歷史水準，國防業務一次性支出對現金流的拖累也將大幅減少。Akers 將波音 2027 年自由現金流預測提高至 70 億美元，高於市場平均預估的 62.3 億美元。
隨著研發成本、客戶補償與舊有國防業務支出逐步下降，他預估波音自由現金流到 2030 年可達約 160 億美元，對應股價約 450 美元，約為目前水準的兩倍，並有望創下 2019 年以來新高。
波音股價今年以來僅上漲約 4.2%，落後標普 500 指數的 10.6%。不過，法國巴黎銀行轉為看多後，《彭博》追蹤的分析師已有逾 80% 建議買進波音，其餘則給予持有評等。
paras_en: According to foreign media reports, Boeing’s 737 Max 7 has finally received certification from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) after nearly a decade of scrutiny, ending a long process that was hampered by two fatal crashes and quality‑issue concerns. At the same time, the only major bearish house on Boeing, BNP Paribas, sharply upgraded its investment rating, saying the stock could climb to $450 by 2030, prompting Boeing (BA‑US) to jump as much as 6.8% mid‑day on Monday (the 3rd).

The FAA said it has issued a revised type certification for the 737 Max 7, a approval that reflects years of regulatory and Boeing work to resolve complex technical problems and a comprehensive review of the aircraft’s design and related safety analyses.

Boeing said it is working with Southwest Airlines (LUV‑US) to deliver the first 737 Max 7. The model can seat 135‑160 passengers, has a maximum range of about 3,800 nautical miles, and its primary customer is Southwest. Boeing’s website shows that 282 Max 7 aircraft remain on order but not yet delivered.

Boeing Commercial Airplanes CEO Stephanie Pope told employees that obtaining the certification is a pivotal moment in the company’s recovery and will allow Boeing to meet future demand on more favorable terms.

Boeing expects to secure certification for the 737 Max 10 later this year. Bloomberg previously reported that the Max 10, which can carry up to 210 passengers, could be approved in the fall. Certifying both models is critical for completing the 737 product line, boosting cash flow and improving the balance sheet.

BNP Paribas analyst Matthew Akers on the same day raised Boeing’s rating by two notches, from “underperform” to “outperform,” and lifted the price target to $300, tying the firm with Baird for the highest target among Bloomberg‑tracked analysts.

Akers said the market has underestimated Boeing’s free‑cash‑flow outlook. With the Max series and parts of the 777 line gradually receiving certification and the company cutting debt, operational risk should fall markedly over the next year. He believes the post‑COVID‑19 era of uncertainty is over and that the stock can break out of the $150‑$250 range that has persisted since early 2020.

He projects Boeing’s net leverage will return to near‑pre‑pandemic historical levels within a year, and one‑off defense‑spending outlays will cease to weigh heavily on cash flow. Akers raised his 2027 free‑cash‑flow estimate for Boeing to $7 billion, above the market consensus of $6.23 billion.

As R&D costs, customer compensation and legacy defense expenses decline, he forecasts Boeing’s free cash flow could reach roughly $16 billion by 2030, implying a share price of about $450 – roughly double the current level and potentially a new high since 2019.

Boeing’s stock has risen only about 4.2% year‑to‑date, lagging the S&P 500’s 10.6% gain. However, after BNP Paribas turned bullish, more than 80% of Bloomberg‑tracked analysts now recommend buying Boeing, with the remainder rating it a hold.

items.title: 蘋果再度槓上英國政府！拒絕開放用戶加密雲端資料
items.title_en: Apple Again Takes on UK Government Over Refusal to Open Encrypted Cloud Data
paras: 蘋果 (AAPL-US) 針對英國政府要求存取用戶加密資料的最新措施再次提起法律挑戰，試圖阻止當局在其產品與服務中建立俗稱「後門」的存取管道。
英國《金融時報》(FT)周一 (3 日) 報導，蘋果上月已向英國調查權力法庭提出申訴。該機構是負責審查情報與執法機關監控行為的獨立司法機構。爭議焦點在於英國內政部要求蘋果提供技術能力，使當局能夠存取英國用戶經過端對端加密的雲端備份資料。
英國政府去年曾提出範圍更廣的要求，希望取得英國與美國用戶的加密資料，但在與川普政府協商數月後撤回命令。英國當局之後又向蘋果發布新的「技術能力通知」，將適用範圍限縮至英國用戶，不再涵蓋美國用戶。
英國政府發言人拒絕評論正在進行的法律程序與具體執法行動，也未證實或否認是否曾向蘋果發出個別通知。
發言人表示，英國支持強大的加密技術與嚴格的隱私保障，但執法機關在必要且符合比例原則的情況下，也必須能夠取得通訊內容，以保護民眾免受恐怖主義、重大犯罪及兒童性剝削的威脅。
蘋果證實已提出法律申訴，但拒絕進一步說明。該公司過去一再強調，從未替任何產品或服務建立後門或「萬用金鑰」，未來也不會這麼做。
人權組織 Liberty 對外關係主管 Ruth Ehrlich 表示，這起案件極為重要，將長期影響民眾的隱私權。她警告，一旦替加密資料打開後門，個人資料將面臨廣泛風險，英國政府必須正視外界疑慮並承諾保障隱私。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) has launched another legal challenge against the UK government's latest demand for access to users' encrypted data, seeking to block authorities from building a so‑called “backdoor” into its products and services.

The Financial Times reported on Monday (the 3rd) that Apple filed a complaint last month with the UK Investigatory Powers Tribunal, the independent judicial body that reviews surveillance activities by intelligence and law‑enforcement agencies. The dispute centers on the Home Office's request that Apple provide the technical capability for authorities to access UK users' end‑to‑end encrypted cloud backups.

The UK government had previously issued a broader request last year, seeking encrypted data from both UK and US users, but withdrew the order after months of negotiations with the Trump administration. It later issued a new “technical capability notice” to Apple, limiting the scope to UK users only and no longer covering US users.
A government spokesperson declined to comment on the ongoing legal proceedings or specific enforcement actions, and did not confirm or deny whether any individual notice had been sent to Apple.

The spokesperson said the UK supports strong encryption and robust privacy protections, but law‑enforcement must be able to obtain communications content when necessary and proportionate to protect the public from terrorism, serious crime and child sexual exploitation.

Apple confirmed it has lodged the legal complaint but refused to provide further details. The company has repeatedly stressed that it has never built a backdoor or “master key” for any product or service and will not do so in the future.

Liberty’s head of external affairs, Ruth Ehrlich, said the case is extremely important and will have long‑term implications for privacy rights. She warned that opening a backdoor to encrypted data would expose personal information to widespread risk, and that the UK government must address external concerns and commit to safeguarding privacy.

items.title: 高盛：AI股震盪非牛市終點 企業Q2獲利仍是最大靠山
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs: AI Stock Volatility Is Not the End of the Bull Market; Corporate Q2 Earnings Remain the Biggest Support
paras: 高盛集團 (GS-US) 最新研究指出，投資人不應將近期人工智慧 (AI) 概念股的大幅波動視為整體股市崩盤的前兆。該行認為，雖然市場動能驅動的科技股出現明顯修正，但企業獲利依舊強勁、盈餘預期持續上修，且越來越多跡象顯示，AI 龐大投資已開始轉化為實際回報，因此市場關注焦點已由 AI 支出是否過高，轉向企業獲利能否持續支撐這波投資浪潮。
高盛美國首席股票策略師 Ben Snider 表示，近期 AI 相關股票遭拋售的走勢雖然來得突然，但與歷史上動能交易過度集中的修正模式相當類似。根據過往經驗，這類行情通常會先經歷一段整理期，再重新回到長期上升趨勢，而非演變成全面性的熊市。
高盛也指出，避險基金及交易所交易基金 (ETF) 投資人近期已大幅降低槓桿水準，有助於減緩市場波動。整體而言，目前市場基本面遠比近期股價表現所反映的更加健康。
報告認為，AI 相關交易未來仍可能持續出現劇烈輪動與震盪，但只要企業獲利沒有明顯惡化，本輪牛市仍將建立在企業盈餘持續成長的基礎，而非純粹由投機資金推動。
高盛表示，今年第二季財報表現是支撐美股的重要因素。截至 7 月 31 日，標普 500 指數約三分之二市值權重的企業已公布第二季財報，其中 64% 的企業獲利至少較華爾街預期高出 1 個標準差，創下歷來最強勁財報季之一。
該行估算，若排除少數科技巨頭帶來的異常龐大投資收益，標普 500 企業第二季獲利年增率仍達 26%；若將這些收益納入計算，核心獲利年增率更高達 45%。
即使表現中等的企業也普遍優於市場預期。高盛估計，標普 500 企業第二季整體獲利成長率約 12%，高於分析師本季初預估的 9%，顯示企業獲利動能持續改善。
Snider 指出，AI 基礎設施供應鏈仍是企業獲利成長最主要的推動力量。高盛估計，AI 基礎設施企業貢獻了標普 500 第二季約三分之一的獲利增長，預估 2026 年剩餘時間及 2027 年，占比將超過五成。
其中，Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜 (AMZN-US)、微軟 (MSFT-US)、輝達 (NVDA-US) 及博通 (AVGO-US) 仍是 AI 獲利成長的主要受益企業。
不過，高盛也強調，企業獲利改善並非僅集中於 AI 受惠族群。排除超大型科技股影響後，以等權重計算的標普 500 指數仍持續走高，反映企業整體基本面依舊穩健，市場漲勢已逐漸擴散至更多產業。
強勁財報也帶動華爾街持續調高未來獲利預測。高盛指出，自第三季開始以來，市場對標普 500 企業 2027 年每股盈餘 (EPS) 預估已上修約 1%，且多數產業均獲調升，其中能源及金融類股上修幅度最大。
然而，高盛提醒，企業獲利率仍是後續觀察重點。報告指出，多數企業已大致吸收關稅及能源成本上升帶來的衝擊，但分析師已開始下調不少企業的利潤率預測，顯示即使營收維持穩健，成本壓力仍可能侵蝕未來獲利能力。
在 AI 投資方面，高盛認為，超大型雲端服務業者並未放慢支出腳步，反而持續加碼投資。Alphabet、亞馬遜及微軟第二季雲端業務營收年增率達 48%，高於前一季的 39%；Meta Platforms (META-US) 的營收成長亦符合市場預期，使分析師進一步調高未來資本支出預估。
高盛最新估計，到 2027 年，全球超大型資料中心營運商的資本支出將突破 1 兆美元，較本次財報季開始前預估增加逾 1000 億美元。
不過，高額投資也帶來龐大的資金需求。數據顯示，五大超大型雲端企業第二季合計資本支出高達 1820 億美元，但同期自由現金流僅約 50 億美元，兩者落差高達 1770 億美元。為填補資金缺口，這些企業本季透過發債及股權融資合計募得約 1010 億美元。
高盛認為，市場不應將大規模融資視為警訊，反而代表投資人相信 AI 投資未來能帶來足夠的營收與獲利成長，以支撐持續擴大的資本支出。該行分析師預期，即使未來兩年資本支出持續攀升，雲端服務供應商的營收成長速度仍有望超越支出增幅，進一步鞏固 AI 投資的長期基本面。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs Group (GS-US) in its latest research says investors should not view the recent sharp swings in artificial‑intelligence (AI) concept stocks as a harbinger of a broader market collapse. The bank believes that although momentum‑driven tech stocks have undergone a noticeable correction, corporate profits remain strong, earnings forecasts continue to be revised upward, and an increasing number of signs show that massive AI investments are beginning to translate into real returns. Consequently, market focus has shifted from whether AI spending is excessive to whether corporate earnings can keep sustaining this wave of investment.

Chief U.S. equity strategist Ben Snider of Goldman said the recent sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, while abrupt, resembles historical correction patterns that follow overly concentrated momentum trading. Past experience shows such moves typically go through a consolidation phase before resuming a long‑term uptrend, rather than turning into a full‑blown bear market.

Goldman also notes that hedge funds and exchange‑traded fund (ETF) investors have recently cut leverage sharply, which helps dampen market volatility. Overall, the market’s fundamentals are far healthier than recent price action suggests.

The report says AI‑related trading may continue to see sharp rotation and volatility, but as long as corporate earnings do not deteriorate markedly, this bull market will remain built on sustained earnings growth rather than pure speculative money.

Goldman points to Q2 earnings as a key driver of U.S. equity strength. As of July 31, companies representing roughly two‑thirds of the S&P 500’s market‑cap weight had reported Q2 results, and 64% of them posted profits at least one standard deviation above Wall Street expectations – one of the strongest earnings seasons on record.

Excluding a few tech giants that generated unusually large investment returns, Goldman estimates that S&P 500 companies’ Q2 earnings grew year‑over‑year by 26%; including those returns, core earnings growth reaches as high as 45%.

Even mid‑range performers generally beat expectations. Goldman estimates overall S&P 500 earnings growth for Q2 at about 12%, above analysts’ early‑season forecast of 9%, indicating continued improvement in earnings momentum.

Snider highlights that the AI infrastructure supply chain remains the primary engine of corporate earnings growth. Goldman estimates AI‑infrastructure firms contributed roughly one‑third of the S&P 500’s Q2 earnings increase, and expects that share to exceed 50% for the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.
Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Broadcom (AVGO-US) remain the main beneficiaries of AI‑driven earnings growth.

However, Goldman stresses that earnings improvement is not confined to AI beneficiaries. Removing the influence of mega‑tech stocks, an equal‑weight S&P 500 index still climbs, reflecting a solid overall corporate backdrop and a market rally that is spreading to more sectors.

Strong earnings have prompted Wall Street to keep raising future profit forecasts. Goldman notes that since the start of Q3, the market’s 2027 EPS estimate for S&P 500 companies has been lifted by about 1%, with most sectors upgraded, especially energy and financials which saw the biggest revisions.

Goldman cautions that earnings margins remain a key watch‑point. The report says most companies have largely absorbed the impact of higher tariffs and energy costs, but analysts are beginning to trim margin forecasts for many firms, indicating that even with steady revenue, cost pressures could erode future profitability.

Regarding AI spending, Goldman sees the largest cloud providers maintaining, even accelerating, their outlays. Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft posted a 48% YoY growth in cloud revenue in Q2, up from 39% in the prior quarter; Meta Platforms (META-US) also met growth expectations, prompting analysts to raise future cap‑ex estimates.
Goldman now projects that by 2027 global ultra‑large data‑center operators will spend over $1 trillion on cap‑ex, more than $100 billion higher than estimates made before this earnings season.

But massive spending creates a huge funding gap. Data show the five biggest cloud firms together spent $182 billion on cap‑ex in Q2 while generating only about $5 billion of free cash flow, a shortfall of roughly $177 billion. To bridge the gap, they raised about $101 billion this quarter through debt and equity issuance.

Goldman believes the scale of financing should not be seen as a warning sign; rather, it shows investors trust that AI investment will eventually deliver sufficient revenue and profit growth to support the expanding cap‑ex. Analysts expect that even if cap‑ex continues to rise over the next two years, cloud service providers’ revenue growth will outpace spending increases, further cementing the long‑term fundamentals of AI investment.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉川普給伊朗「最後一次機會」道瓊飆近700點創新猷 亞馬遜市值破3兆美元
items.title_en: US Stocks Soar as Tensions with Iran Ease, Dow Surges Nearly 700 Points to New High
paras: 美股週一 (3 日) 全面收高，大型科技股強勢反彈，加上美國總統川普取消對伊朗的攻擊計畫，帶動國際油價重挫，市場風險偏好明顯回升。道瓊勁揚近 700 點並刷新收盤紀錄，那斯達克指數大漲逾 2%，標普 500 指數則逼近歷史高點。
除了科技股回溫，美伊緊張局勢出現降溫跡象，也是推動股市走高的重要因素。
儘管伊朗否認正與美國直接協商，美國總統川普宣稱雙方仍在接觸，第一階段將處理荷姆茲海峽重新開放問題，之後再推進伊朗非核化談判。
川普週一也對伊朗發出最後通牒，警告德黑蘭這是簽署一份良好文件的「最後機會」，否則可能面臨「斬首」。
國際油價應聲重挫，布蘭特原油期貨下跌 4.73%，收每桶 83.77 美元；西德州中級原油期貨下挫 5.11%，收每桶 80.34 美元。油價回落也稍微減輕市場對通膨重新升溫的疑慮。
美債殖利率同步下滑，基準 10 年期美債殖利率下降近 6 個基點至約 4.688%，反映油價下跌後，市場對通膨壓力的擔憂略有緩和。
經濟數據方面，美國供應管理協會 (ISM) 公布，7 月製造業採購經理人指數 (PMI) 較前月上升 2.3 個百分點至 55.6，高於代表產業擴張的 50 榮枯線，顯示製造業活動持續改善。
本週最關注的數據是週五公布的 7 月非農就業報告。市場預期新增就業人數將進一步增加，數據可望為美國勞動市場狀況及聯準會後續政策方向提供更多線索。
美股週一 (3 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭多數走高。Meta (META-US) 強漲 6.02%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 1.78%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 大漲 4.88%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 大漲 4.93%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 大漲 4.58%。
費城半導體族群全面收紅。AMD (AMD-US) 上漲 1.78%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 0.76%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 大漲 2.93%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 上漲 2.08%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 2.68%；美光 (MU-US) 上漲 0.79%。

企業新聞
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下滑約 1.8%，收在 303.42 美元，連續第四個交易日收黑，由於 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 市值超越蘋果，使蘋果跌至全美市值第三大企業。

SpaceX (SPCX-US) 勁揚 5.68%，收在每股 114.53 美元。馬斯克旗下這家人工智慧與火箭公司將於週二公布第二季財報。截至週一收盤，SpaceX 股價仍較 135 美元的首次公開募股 (IPO) 價格低約 15.2%。
波音 (BA-US) 暴漲 8%，收在 233.49 美元。該公司同時獲得罕見的「雙重升評」及美國聯邦航空總署 (FAA) 的飛機認證。法國巴黎銀行將波音評等由「賣出」一口氣調升至「買進」，並將目標價由 230 美元提高至 300 美元。

Founder ETFs 投資組合經理 Michael Monaghan 表示，上週前 OpenAI 研究員 Leopold Aschenbrenner 創辦的避險基金 Situational Awareness 遭清算後，壓抑 AI 類股的賣壓已逐漸消退；與此同時，市場原本擔憂週末期間中東局勢進一步惡化，但目前美方的言論與態度顯示，各方正嘗試透過談判解決問題。

paras_en: US stocks rose broadly on Monday, with major tech stocks rebounding strongly, as President Trump canceled a planned attack on Iran, leading to a sharp decline in international oil prices and a significant increase in risk appetite. The Dow Jones Industrial Average surged nearly 700 points to a new record high, while the Nasdaq Composite Index jumped over 2% and the S&P 500 Index approached its historic high.

In addition to the rebound in tech stocks, the easing of tensions between the US and Iran was also a key factor driving the stock market higher. Despite Iran's denial of direct negotiations with the US, President Trump claimed that the two sides were still in contact, with the first phase focusing on the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, followed by negotiations on Iran's nuclear program.

Trump also issued an ultimatum to Iran on Monday, warning Tehran that this was the 'last chance' to sign a good agreement, or face 'decapitation'. International oil prices plummeted in response, with Brent crude oil futures falling 4.73% to $83.77 per barrel and West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil futures dropping 5.11% to $80.34 per barrel. The decline in oil prices also slightly eased concerns about a resurgence in inflation.

US bond yields fell in tandem, with the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield declining nearly 6 basis points to around 4.688%, reflecting the market's reduced concerns about inflation pressure following the drop in oil prices.

On the economic data front, the Institute for Supply Management (ISM) reported that the US manufacturing purchasing managers' index (PMI) rose 2.3 percentage points to 55.6 in July, above the 50 threshold that separates expansion from contraction, indicating a continued improvement in manufacturing activity.

The most closely watched data this week is the July non-farm payroll report, which is scheduled to be released on Friday. The market expects the number of new jobs to increase further, providing more clues about the state of the US labor market and the Federal Reserve's future policy direction.

The major US stock indexes performed as follows on Monday: the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 693.38 points, or 1.32%, to 53,178.41; the Nasdaq Composite Index surged 540.04 points, or 2.13%, to 25,913.90; the S&P 500 Index gained 110.78 points, or 1.48%, to 7,600.50; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 119.28 points, or 1.05%, to 11,430.35; and the NYSE FANG+ Index jumped 490.80 points, or 2.84%, to 17,752.15.

In focus, most of the big tech stocks in the NYSE FANG+ Index rose. Meta (META-US) soared 6.02%, while Apple (AAPL-US) fell 1.78%. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) surged 4.88%, Microsoft (MSFT-US) jumped 4.93%, and Amazon (AMZN-US) rose 4.58%.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was broadly higher, with AMD (AMD-US) up 1.78%, Broadcom (AVGO-US) rising 0.76%, Nvidia (NVDA-US) surging 2.93%, Applied Materials (AMAT-US) gaining 2.08%, Qualcomm (QCOM-US) up 2.68%, and Micron (MU-US) rising 0.79%.
Taiwanese stocks were mixed, with TSMC ADR (TSM-US) up 0.46%, ASE ADR (ASX-US) surging 4.29%, UMC ADR (UMC-US) falling 1.79%, and Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT-US) down 0.42%.

In company news, Apple (AAPL-US) fell about 1.8% to $303.42, its fourth consecutive decline, as Alphabet's (GOOGL-US) market capitalization surpassed Apple's, making Apple the third-largest US company by market value.

Amazon (AMZN-US) soared 4.58% to a record high of $284.02, its best day since May 5, with its market capitalization exceeding $3 trillion for the first time. Amazon's rally continued from last week's strong second-quarter earnings report, which beat market expectations.
SpaceX (SPCX-US) rose 5.68% to $114.53 ahead of its second-quarter earnings report on Tuesday. As of Monday's close, SpaceX's stock price was still about 15.2% below its IPO price of $135.

Boeing (BA-US) surged 8% to $233.49 after receiving a rare 'double upgrade' and certification from the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). BNP Paribas upgraded Boeing's rating from 'sell' to 'buy' and raised its target price from $230 to $300.
Alibaba ADR (BABA-US) jumped 4.13% to $127.30 after the Chinese e-commerce giant released its new AI model, Qwen 3.8-Max, which boosted market confidence.

According to Michael Monaghan, portfolio manager at Founder ETFs, the selling pressure on AI-related stocks has eased after the liquidation of Situational Awareness, a hedge fund founded by former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner. Meanwhile, the market's concerns about the Middle East situation over the weekend have been alleviated by the US's rhetoric and attitude, which suggest that all parties are trying to resolve the issue through negotiations.

However, investors remain cautious. Adam Crisafulli, founder of Vital Knowledge, noted that similar easing of tensions has occurred in the past, and the US-Iran conflict is still far from being truly resolved, so the market's willingness to chase prices remains relatively restrained.

items.title: 川普支持度跌至35%！路透民調：民主黨近十年首度在經濟議題超越共和黨
items.title_en: Trump Approval Drops to 35% – Reuters/Ipsos Poll Shows Democrats Surpass Republicans on Economic Issues for First Time in a Decade
paras: 最新路透 / 益普索 (Reuters/Ipsos) 民調顯示，美國選民近十年來首度認為民主黨比共和黨更有能力管理經濟，與此同時，美國總統川普的施政滿意度下滑至 35%，反映能源價格上漲及伊朗戰事對民生造成的壓力，正逐漸侵蝕共和黨在經濟議題上的傳統優勢，也為 11 月國會期中選舉投下變數。
這項民調於上周三至本周一進行，結果顯示，川普施政滿意度由上月調查的 37% 降至 35%，距離其本屆任期最低紀錄僅差 1 個百分點。
在經濟議題方面，37% 的已登記選民認為民主黨提出的經濟政策較佳，略高於支持共和黨的 36%；另有 27% 的受訪者表示不確定，或認為其他政黨能有更好的表現。
這也是近十年來，路透 / 益普索民調首次顯示民主黨在經濟議題上取得領先。共和黨自川普第一任期 (2017 年至 2021 年) 以來，一直到民主黨籍前總統拜登執政四年，以及川普第二任期初期，都一直維持經濟議題的優勢。雖然 2017 年 5 月一項路透 / 益普索調查也曾顯示民主黨領先，但當時問卷設計不同，並未提供「不確定」或「其他政黨」等選項，因此兩者無法直接比較。
調查指出，共和黨在經濟議題上的優勢於川普本屆任期持續縮小，近期更已完全消失。分析認為，美國與以色列今年 2 月對伊朗發動軍事行動後，中東衝突持續延燒，推升國際能源價格，美國家庭生活成本明顯增加，是影響選民態度的重要因素。
川普曾表示，下令對伊朗採取軍事行動，是為了摧毀伊朗核計畫、削弱其攻擊區域對手的能力，並創造推翻伊朗神權政府的條件。然而，自戰事爆發以來，美國汽油價格已累計上漲逾 25%，平均每加侖油價增加超過 1 美元，對家庭支出形成壓力。
若國會選舉此刻舉行，42% 的已登記選民表示將支持民主黨候選人，37% 支持共和黨；無黨籍選民更有 12 個百分點的差距偏向民主黨。
共和黨目前在聯邦參、眾兩院皆握有些微多數席次，11 月 3 日舉行的期中選舉將決定未來兩年國會控制權，因此此次民調被視為共和黨的重要警訊。
不過，民調也指出，全國支持度未必能直接反映實際選舉結果。美國眾議院 435 席中，真正具有競爭性的選區僅約 30 多席；參議院方面，預計只有約 8 席將成為勝負關鍵，因此最終結果仍取決於少數搖擺選區的選情。
面對近期多項顯示支持度下滑的民調，川普則持續表達質疑。他在本周一、最新民調公布前於 Truth Social 發文表示，「我真正的民調數字，不是那些假新聞媒體捏造出來的數字，是我有史以來最好的。」
本次路透 / 益普索全美網路民調共訪問 4,505 名美國成年人，抽樣誤差為正負 2 個百分點。
paras_en: The latest Reuters/Ipsos poll shows that U.S. voters, for the first time in ten years, believe the Democratic Party is more capable of managing the economy than the Republican Party. At the same time, President Donald Trump’s job approval has slipped to 35%, reflecting pressure from rising energy prices and the war in Iran that is affecting everyday life, gradually eroding the GOP’s traditional advantage on economic issues and adding a variable to the November midterm elections.

The poll, conducted from last Wednesday to this Monday, shows Trump’s approval falling from 37% in the previous month’s survey to 35%, just one percentage point away from the lowest level recorded in his current term.

On economic issues, 37% of registered voters say the Democrats’ economic policies are better, slightly ahead of the 36% who back the Republicans; another 27% are unsure or think another party could perform better.

This is the first time in nearly a decade that a Reuters/Ipsos poll has shown Democrats leading the Republicans on the economy. Since Trump’s first term (2017‑2021), through President Biden’s four years and the early part of Trump’s second term, Republicans have maintained an edge on economic issues. Although a May 2017 Reuters/Ipsos survey also showed a Democratic lead, that questionnaire did not include “unsure” or “other parties” options, so the results are not directly comparable.

The survey notes that the GOP’s advantage on economic issues has been shrinking throughout Trump’s current term and has now disappeared entirely. Analysts say that after the United States and Israel launched military actions against Iran in February, the ongoing Middle‑East conflict has pushed up global energy prices, noticeably raising U.S. household living costs and influencing voter attitudes.

Trump has said the order to take military action against Iran was meant to destroy Iran’s nuclear program, weaken its ability to attack regional foes, and create conditions for toppling the theocratic regime. However, since the war began, U.S. gasoline prices have risen by more than 25% overall, with the average price per gallon increasing by over $1, putting pressure on family budgets.

If a congressional election were held today, 42% of registered voters say they would support Democratic candidates, 37% would back Republicans, and unaffiliated voters lean Democratic by a margin of 12 percentage points.

Republicans currently hold a slim majority in both chambers of Congress, and the November 3 midterms will decide control of the House and Senate for the next two years, making this poll a serious warning sign for the GOP.

Nevertheless, the poll also points out that national support levels do not necessarily translate directly into election outcomes. Of the 435 House seats, only about 30‑plus are truly competitive, and in the Senate roughly eight seats are expected to be decisive, so the final result will hinge on a handful of swing districts.

Facing a series of polls showing declining support, Trump continues to cast doubt on the numbers. On Monday, before the latest poll was released, he posted on Truth Social that “My real poll numbers aren’t those fake‑news media‑made figures – they’re the best I’ve ever had.”
The Reuters/Ipsos nationwide online poll interviewed 4,505 U.S. adults, with a margin of error of plus or minus 2 percentage points.

items.title: 川普下最後通牒！伊朗不達協議將面臨「斬首」
items.title_en: Trump Issues Ultimatum to Iran, Warning of 'Decapitation' if No Deal is Reached
paras: 美國總統川普週一 (3 日) 對伊朗發出最後通牒，警告德黑蘭若不把握「最後機會」與美國達成和平協議，可能面臨「斬首」。川普宣稱雙方目前仍在接觸，第一階段將處理荷姆茲海峽重新開放問題，之後再推進伊朗非核化談判，但伊朗否認正與美國直接協商。
川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室表示，這一輪談判「並不複雜」，預料進展速度將比以往更快。他聲稱，荷姆茲海峽最快「明天」就可能全面開放，並將其稱為協議的第一階段。
待海峽通航問題解決後，雙方將進入第二階段，討論伊朗非核化。川普坦言，相關談判可能需要一段時間，並再次強調伊朗必須實現非核化；不過，伊朗一向堅稱其核計畫僅供民用。
川普說：「這是他們簽署一份好協議的『最後機會』。」
當記者追問這次談判與過去有何不同時，他進一步表示，希望在採取「斬首」行動前，給伊朗所有可能的「最後機會」。
川普並未說明「斬首」的具體含義，但透露美方原定採取的軍事行動尚未完全取消，並形容相關計畫「非常強硬」。
他表示，執行這項行動並非容易的決定，美方將視後續情勢發展再作判斷。
川普上週曾警告將「非常猛烈地」打擊伊朗，攻擊範圍可能包括能源基礎設施，但週末暫緩空襲，轉而繼續尋求外交解決。他宣稱，美方原本規劃的攻勢一旦展開，將成為「第二次世界大戰以來規模最大的攻擊」。
川普表示，沙烏地阿拉伯、阿拉伯聯合大公國、卡達等國領袖曾聯繫華府，希望美國再給外交斡旋一次機會，因此他決定暫緩軍事行動。
不過，美伊雙方對談判狀態的說法明顯矛盾。
伊朗外交部表示，德黑蘭並未與華府協商重開荷姆茲海峽或終結戰爭，目前僅與阿曼討論設置一條「臨時航線」，讓船隻安全通過這條重要能源運輸走廊。
川普隨即在社群平台 Truth Social 痛批伊朗領導階層「令人難以置信地口是心非」。他聲稱，伊朗方面主動尋求會談，甚至可以說是在「懇求」談判，卻又公開宣稱沒有與美國接觸。
川普表示，無論伊朗是否願意承認，美伊都在尋找解決方案。他並警告，在達成協議或伊朗「全面投降」以前，美國將繼續限制物資進入伊朗。
《CBS News》則引述消息人士指出，目前並未安排任何美伊之間的「新一輪」直接談判，雙方只是持續透過中間人傳遞訊息。因此，川普所稱的談判可能是指間接接觸，而非正式的面對面協商。
美國與以色列 2 月 28 日對伊朗發動突襲，華府與德黑蘭隨即陷入戰爭。雙方 6 月曾透過一份諒解備忘錄達成停火，原本希望以此作為推動更廣泛和平談判的基礎，但停火協議隔月便因雙方恢復互相攻擊而破裂。
川普此後多次在大規模軍事威脅與外交談判之間轉換立場。由於伊朗否認正與美國直接談判，雙方在荷姆茲海峽管理權及核計畫等議題上仍存在重大分歧，這一輪接觸能否促成停火或更廣泛的和平協議，仍待觀察。

Trump claimed that the two sides are still in contact, with the first phase focusing on the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, followed by negotiations on Iran's denuclearization. However, Iran has denied direct negotiations with the US.

Trump stated in the Oval Office that this round of negotiations is 'not complicated' and is expected to progress faster than before. He claimed that the Strait of Hormuz could be fully reopened as early as 'tomorrow', calling it the first phase of the agreement.

After the issue of the strait's navigation is resolved, the two sides will enter the second phase to discuss Iran's denuclearization. Trump admitted that the related negotiations may take some time and again emphasized that Iran must achieve denuclearization. However, Iran has consistently claimed that its nuclear program is for civilian use only.

Trump said, 'This is their last chance to sign a good agreement.' When asked by reporters what is different about this round of negotiations compared to the past, he further stated that he wants to give Iran every possible 'last chance' before taking 'decapitation' action.

Trump did not elaborate on the meaning of 'decapitation' but revealed that the US has not completely canceled the planned military action and described the plan as 'very tough'. He stated that executing this action is not an easy decision, and the US will make a judgment based on the development of the situation.

Trump had previously warned that he would 'very strongly' strike Iran, with potential targets including energy infrastructure, but suspended the airstrike over the weekend and continued to seek a diplomatic solution. He claimed that the planned attack, if launched, would be 'the largest attack since World War II'.

Trump stated that the leaders of Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Qatar had contacted Washington, hoping that the US would give diplomacy another chance, which is why he decided to suspend military action.

However, the US and Iran have clearly contradictory statements about the status of the negotiations. The Iranian Foreign Ministry stated that Tehran has not negotiated with Washington on reopening the Strait of Hormuz or ending the war and is currently only discussing the establishment of a 'temporary navigation line' with Oman to allow ships to safely pass through this important energy transportation corridor.

Trump immediately criticized the Iranian leadership on the social media platform Truth Social, calling them 'incredibly dishonest'. He claimed that the Iranian side had sought talks, even 'begging' for negotiations, but then publicly claimed they had no contact with the US.

Trump stated that regardless of whether Iran is willing to admit it, both the US and Iran are seeking a solution. He warned that the US will continue to restrict the flow of goods into Iran until an agreement is reached or Iran 'fully surrenders'.

CBS News quoted sources as saying that there are currently no scheduled 'new rounds' of direct negotiations between the US and Iran, and the two sides are only continuing to pass messages through intermediaries. Therefore, the negotiations mentioned by Trump may refer to indirect contact rather than formal face-to-face negotiations.

The US and Israel launched a surprise attack on Iran on February 28, and Washington and Tehran immediately became embroiled in war. The two sides reached a ceasefire through a memorandum of understanding in June, hoping to use it as a basis for promoting broader peace negotiations, but the ceasefire agreement collapsed the following month due to renewed mutual attacks.

Trump has since repeatedly shifted his stance between large-scale military threats and diplomatic negotiations. Due to Iran's denial of direct negotiations with the US, significant differences remain between the two sides on issues such as the management of the Strait of Hormuz and nuclear programs. It remains to be seen whether this round of contact can lead to a ceasefire or a broader peace agreement.

items.title: 資金棄AI轉抱金融股 補漲行情能走多遠看Fed下一步
items.title_en: Funds Shift from AI to Financial Stocks, But How Long Can the Rally Last?
paras: 金融股本月成為市場表現最佳的族群之一，強勁的銀行財報、資本市場活動改善，以及市場對私人信貸風險的擔憂降溫，吸引投資人重新布局這個今年以來落後大盤漲勢的產業。不過，聯準會（Fed）下一步政策動向，可能決定這波資金輪動行情還能延續多久。
標普 500 金融類股近期漲勢正面臨一項考驗，即金融股能否成為更具持續性的市場領漲力量，並為投資人提供科技股與人工智慧（AI）投資主導市場之外的另一項選擇。
Edward Jones 投資策略分析師魏默（Brock Weimer）指出，觀察近期已公布的銀行財報，他認為本月以來的上漲走勢相當合理。不過他也提醒，7 月 29、30 日市場劇烈的震盪再次凸顯出，通膨與利率疑慮仍能迅速扭轉金融股的看漲前景。
財報強勁支撐金融股多頭論點
隨著第二季財報季加速展開，摩根大通 (JPM-US) 、高盛 (GS-US) 與摩根士丹利 (MS-US) 等大型銀行表現搶眼。魏默表示，整體財報表現確實非常出色，且針對民間信貸的隱憂，以及 AI 對數據密集型金融業務構成的威脅，市場焦慮情緒皆已有所緩解。
State Street Investment Management 首席投資策略 Michael Arone 則認為，金融股基本面的好轉，尚未完全反映在其估值中。
根據 FactSet 數據，截至上週五的統計，標普 500 指數金融成分股第二季獲利成長率達 19.4%，營收則成長 12.6%；該產業利潤率亦隨之擴大，在標普 500 指數的 11 個產業板塊中排名第三。
然而，然而，Arone 指出，金融股目前交易價格，仍較大盤折價超過 30%。
Arone 表示，金融股多頭論述並不僅建立在獲利表現上，企業併購（M&A）與首次公開募股（IPO）活動改善、信貸環境穩健，以及銀行股息與庫藏股回購計畫，都進一步提升金融股吸引力。
綜合考量這些因素，State Street 已在第 3 季展望中，將金融股評等由「中立」調升至「正向」。
Fed 政策與殖利率曲線成關鍵
儘管財報強勁，但金融股仍面臨再次升息與通膨居高不下的風險。
Fed 上週連續第 5 次將基準利率維持在 3.5% 至 3.75% 區間不變，但有 3 名官員支持升息，使市場對貨幣政策方向的疑慮升溫。
根據芝商所（CME Group）的 FedWatch 工具顯示，截至上週四下午，期貨交易員預測最快於 9 月升息的機率已來到 63.2%。
利率走向對銀行至關重要，主因銀行通常以短期利率支付存款利息，同時賺取長期貸款與證券的利差。
但若 Fed 升息，且存款成本上升速度快於銀行資產收益率，淨利差（NIM）可能受到壓縮。長期維持高利率環境，也可能削弱貸款需求，並提高未來信用損失風險。
Globalt Investments 合夥人暨資深投資組合經理 Keith Buchanan 表示，這項風險可能抵銷支撐金融股上漲的其他利多因素。
他指出，若通膨阻礙 Fed 降息腳步，甚至迫使央行再次升息，銀行可能必須提高存款利率以留住資金。若長期利率未同步上升，銀行放貸收益與資金成本之間的利差可能收窄，進而壓縮淨利息收入。
paras_en: Financial stocks have become one of the best-performing groups in the market this month, driven by strong bank earnings, improved capital market activity, and easing concerns over private credit risks, attracting investors to reposition in an industry that has lagged the broader market rally so far this year. However, the Federal Reserve's next policy move may determine how long this rotation can last.

The recent rally in S&P 500 financial stocks is facing a test of whether they can become a more sustainable market leader and provide investors with an alternative to tech and AI-driven investments. Edward Jones investment strategy analyst Brock Weimer notes that the recent bank earnings reports have been quite reasonable, but warns that the market's sharp fluctuations on July 29 and 30 highlight that inflation and rate concerns can quickly reverse the outlook for financial stocks.

The strong earnings reports have supported the bullish case for financial stocks. As the second-quarter earnings season gains momentum, major banks such as JPMorgan Chase (JPM-US), Goldman Sachs (GS-US), and Morgan Stanley (MS-US) have delivered impressive performances. Weimer states that the overall earnings performance has been excellent, and concerns over private credit and the threat of AI to data-intensive financial businesses have eased.

Michael Arone, chief investment strategist at State Street Investment Management, believes that the improvement in financial stocks' fundamentals has not been fully reflected in their valuations. According to FactSet data, as of last Friday, the S&P 500 financial sector's second-quarter earnings growth rate reached 19.4%, with revenue growth of 12.6%, and the industry's profit margin has expanded, ranking third among the 11 industry sectors in the S&P 500.

However, Arone notes that financial stocks are still trading at a discount of over 30% to the broader market. Arone argues that the bullish case for financial stocks is not just based on earnings performance, but also on improved M&A and IPO activity, a stable credit environment, and banks' dividend and share buyback plans, which have further enhanced the attractiveness of financial stocks.

Taking these factors into account, State Street has upgraded its outlook for financial stocks from 'neutral' to 'positive' in its third-quarter forecast. Despite strong earnings, financial stocks still face the risk of further rate hikes and high inflation. The Fed left its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.5%-3.75% for the fifth consecutive time last week, but three officials supported a rate hike, fueling market uncertainty about the direction of monetary policy.

According to the CME Group's FedWatch tool, as of last Thursday afternoon, the probability of a rate hike as early as September had risen to 63.2%. The direction of interest rates is crucial for banks, as they typically pay short-term interest rates on deposits and earn a spread on long-term loans and securities. However, if the Fed raises rates and deposit costs rise faster than bank asset yields, net interest margins (NIM) may be compressed.

Globalt Investments partner and senior portfolio manager Keith Buchanan warns that this risk could offset other positive factors supporting the rally in financial stocks. He notes that if inflation prevents the Fed from cutting rates, or even forces it to raise rates again, banks may need to increase deposit rates to retain funds. If long-term rates do not rise in tandem, the spread between bank lending yields and funding costs may narrow, compressing net interest income.

items.title: 製藥業大型併購案醞釀中｜阿斯特捷利康傳洽談必治妥施貴寶
items.title_en: Major Pharmaceutical Merger in the Works: AstraZeneca in Talks with Bristol Myers Squibb
paras: 2026年08月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 英國製藥商阿斯特捷利康AstraZeneca(AZN-US)傳出正與美國藥廠必治妥施貴寶Bristol Myers Squibb(BMY-US)洽談合併。若交易完成，合併後公司市值將接近4000億美元，可望躋身全球規模最大的製藥企業之一，並成為近年全球製藥產業規模最大的併購案之一。
根據《金融時報》報導，雙方近幾個月已就潛在交易展開協商，目前談判仍在進行中。報導指出，交易可能在短期內達成，也可能延後，甚至最終破局。
阿斯特捷利康近年持續擴大腫瘤、罕見疾病及免疫療法布局，核心產品涵蓋肺癌、乳癌等癌症治療，以及ADC藥物與免疫療法；必治妥施貴寶則積極強化細胞治療與血液腫瘤業務，日前才宣布以15億美元現金收購未上市生技公司Orbital Therapeutics，希望藉由其新一代RNA平台，加速開發CAR-T細胞療法，提升治療效率，並擴大該療法的應用。

paras_en: On August 4, 2026, it was reported that UK-based pharmaceutical company AstraZeneca (AZN-US) is in talks with US-based Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY-US) for a potential merger. If the deal is completed, the combined company's market value would be close to $4 trillion, making it one of the largest pharmaceutical companies globally and one of the biggest mergers in the industry in recent years.

According to a report by the Financial Times, the two companies have been in negotiations over a potential deal for several months, with talks still ongoing. The report suggests that the deal could be reached in the short term, but it may also be delayed or ultimately fall through.

Meanwhile, Bristol Myers Squibb has been strengthening its cell therapy and hematological oncology business, recently announcing the acquisition of privately-held biotech company Orbital Therapeutics for $1.5 billion in cash, aiming to accelerate the development of CAR-T cell therapy using Orbital's next-generation RNA platform.

The market believes that if the two companies merge successfully, they will be able to integrate their products and research resources in oncology, immunology, and cell therapy, forming a multi-technology platform that covers targeted therapy, immunotherapy, ADC, and CAR-T cell therapy, further enhancing their global competitiveness.

items.title: 日元反彈外溢亞幣！花旗、巴克萊齊發聲：韓元、新元與泰銖將受惠
items.title_en: Yen's Rebound to Benefit Asian Currencies, Says Citi and Barclays
paras: 美日聯合干預後日元急彈，亞洲貨幣跟漲行情獲華爾街點名，花旗與巴克莱最新客戶報告指出，因多數亞幣與日元走勢高度相關，「日元升值同樣會推動亞洲貨幣走強」，其中韓元、新加坡元、泰銖被列為最直接受惠者。
過去三個交易日裡，日元兌美元累計漲超 4%，脫離近 40 年低點，同期韓元、泰銖、菲律賓披索均升值至少 0.7%，不含日元的一籃子亞洲貨幣上漲 0.5%。
花旗駐新加坡策略師 Garg 與 Goh 在報告中指出，過去一年韓元、新元、新台幣與日元相關性最高，印度盧比與印尼盾最低。
巴克莱駐新加坡的 Kotecha 團隊也表示，韓元兌日元敏感度居亞洲前列，美日干預具協調性，外溢效果將大於歷史β值推算，首爾當局同步拋美元，韓元已升值至 9 個月新高，Fed 主席華許偏鴿導致美元回檔，也放大支撐力道。
不過，花旗與巴克莱均未把這視為趨勢反轉。根本錨點仍是美日利差。美國聯邦基金利率 3.5%–3.75%，日本僅 1%，差距 250–275 基點。
富蘭克林鄧普頓策略師提醒，干預只買時間、難替日本承擔政策代價；布魯金斯學者更直言，只要日債殖利率被人為壓住，日元仍被高估需下行。
中東能源風險、老齡化與產業空心化未解，加上美國這次賣歐元買日元，而非賣美元，讓市場對「聯手干預」成色存疑。
短線來看，日元帶動的亞洲貨幣修復可期；中長線匯率方向仍握在美日央行利差與套利交易手裡。
paras_en: Following the US-Japan joint intervention, the yen has rebounded sharply, and the trend of Asian currencies rising in tandem has been highlighted by Wall Street. According to the latest client reports from Citi and Barclays, since many Asian currencies are highly correlated with the yen, the appreciation of the yen will also drive the strengthening of Asian currencies. The Korean won, Singapore dollar, and Thai baht are expected to be the most direct beneficiaries.

Over the past three trading days, the yen has appreciated by more than 4% against the US dollar, moving away from its nearly 40-year low. During the same period, the Korean won, Thai baht, and Philippine peso have all risen by at least 0.7%, while a basket of Asian currencies excluding the yen has increased by 0.5%.

Citi strategists Garg and Goh stated in their report that over the past year, the Korean won, Singapore dollar, and New Taiwan dollar have had the highest correlation with the yen, while the Indian rupee and Indonesian rupiah have had the lowest correlation.

Barclays' team led by Kotecha in Singapore also noted that the Korean won has the highest sensitivity to the yen among Asian currencies. The coordinated US-Japan intervention will have a greater impact than historical beta calculations, and the Korean government's simultaneous sale of US dollars has driven the won to a nine-month high. The dovish stance of Fed Chairman Powell has also led to a decline in the US dollar, further supporting the won.

However, both Citi and Barclays do not view this as a trend reversal. The fundamental anchor remains the US-Japan interest rate differential, with the US federal funds rate at 3.5%-3.75% and Japan's rate at 1%, resulting in a difference of 250-275 basis points.

Franklin Templeton strategist warned that intervention only buys time and cannot replace the policy costs borne by Japan. A Brookings scholar stated that as long as Japan's bond yields are artificially suppressed, the yen is still overvalued and needs to decline. The unresolved issues of Middle East energy risks, aging population, and industrial hollowing, combined with the US selling euros to buy yen instead of selling US dollars, have raised doubts about the effectiveness of the joint intervention.

In the short term, the yen-led recovery of Asian currencies is expected. However, the medium- to long-term direction of exchange rates remains in the hands of the US-Japan central bank interest rate differential and arbitrage trading.
